entities.summary: Amnat Ruenroeng is a Thai former professional Muay Thai fighter, kickboxer, and professional boxer. He is a former Lumpinee Stadium Super Flyweight Champion in Muay Thai as well as a former IBF Flyweight Champion in boxing. He also competed in the 2008 Summer Olympics.
